reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was 'Every batch lab-tested' with the QR on the box, then the pocket-size sachets that tear open with one hand, which would actually live in my gym bag. I'd grab one box on impulse if a creator I follow nails the sleep and muscle recovery thing, but I'd only do it once to see how it goes.
objection: 30 foil packets a month is a lot of trash for something I take every day, and I'm paying extra for the packaging when a bottle of capsules would be cheaper.
would_change_my_mind: A bigger-pack or subscribe-and-save price, or a recyclable or refill option for the sachets.
